Comment: Remove lock_factory from config.php and restart php-fpm

commands: echo '=== Current lock_factory lines in config.php ==='
grep -n 'lock_factory' /app/moodle/config.php && echo 'Found (will remove)' || echo 'None found (already clean)'
grep -n 'lock_factory' /app/moodle/config.php && echo 'STILL PRESENT - check manually' || echo 'Removed OK'
php -l /app/moodle/config.php && echo 'config.php syntax OK' || echo 'SYNTAX ERROR'
echo '=== Restart PHP-FPM on this instance ==='
systemctl restart php-fpm && echo 'php-fpm restarted OK'
